description: This file contains functions for inferring symbol values based on constraints, involving symbolic mathematics with sympy, and handling tensor dimension constraints in PyTorch, specifically for shape inference.

methods.name: infer_symbol_values
methods.description: Main function to infer symbol values based on various shape constraints expressed as strings.

methods.name: calculate_value
methods.description: Calculates and updates the value of a symbol based on an equation.

methods.name: solve_equation
methods.description: Solves an equation for a variable, handling special cases with parentheses.

methods.name: update_equation
methods.description: Updates the symbolic equation with new constraints and computes least common multiple for padding constraints.
